title: One Question, Four Voices: How Advice for Alzheimer's Caregiving Differs Between Caregivers, Clinicians, and Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.18604v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Online caregiver forums are an important source of emotional and informational support for Alzheimer's disease and related dementias (ADRD). We compare responses to 85 real caregiver questions from ALZConnected across four responder groups: peer caregivers, physicians, ChatGPT, and a retrieval-augmented CareGPT grounded in peer discussions. Using 28 measures spanning linguistic form, emotional support, informational support, and topic scope, we examine how these voices differ when answering the same questions. Peers provided time-anchored narratives and community grounding; clinicians offered concise, advice-forward, clinically bounded guidance; and LLMs produced a formal, verbose, highly structured consultation style. CareGPT showed minimal measurable separation from ChatGPT, suggesting that retrieval plus prompt injection alone was insufficient to shift communicative stance. translated_title: 一问四声：阿尔茨海默病照护建议在照护者、临床医生与大型语言模型之间有何不同
translated_abstract: 在线照护者论坛是阿尔茨海默病及相关痴呆（ADRD）照护者获取情感与信息支持的重要来源。我们比较了四个回答群体对来自ALZConnected的85个真实照护者问题的回应：同伴照护者、医生、ChatGPT，以及基于同伴讨论构建的检索增强型CareGPT。通过涵盖语言形式、情感支持、信息支持和主题范围的28项测量指标，我们考察了这些不同的声音在回答相同问题时的差异。同伴照护者提供了以时间为锚的叙事和社区依托；临床医生给出了简洁、以建议为主、临床上有边界的指导；而大语言模型则呈现出正式、冗长、高度结构化的咨询风格。CareGPT与ChatGPT之间的可测量差异极小，这表明仅靠检索加提示注入不足以改变模型的沟通立场。大语言模型的输出在礼貌性和情感表达方面的得分高于同伴照护者。
tldr: 该研究用28项指标比较同伴照护者、医生、ChatGPT与检索增强型CareGPT对85个真实阿尔茨海默病照护问题的回答，发现各群体沟通风格截然不同，而仅靠检索增强不足以让CareGPT摆脱ChatGPT正式冗长的咨询式风格。
en_tdlr: This study compares responses to 85 real Alzheimer's caregiving questions from peer caregivers, physicians, ChatGPT, and a retrieval-augmented CareGPT across 28 measures, revealing distinct communicative styles among groups and showing that retrieval augmentation alone fails to shift CareGPT away from ChatGPT's formal, verbose consultation style.
